title: PracticePay Patient Financing Returned-Item Fee Level
content:
**Rule.** The returned-item fee level of a PracticePay Patient Financing returned-payment fee follows the plan's returned-payment record: when the plan shows two or more returned-payment entries dated within the last 6 months and at least one late fee dated within the last 6 months, the returned-item fee level is 25.00 USD; when the plan shows exactly one returned-payment entry dated within the last 6 months and no late fee dated within the last 12 months, the returned-item fee level is 10.00 USD; for any other plan the returned-item fee level is the plan's returned-payment fee of 15.00 USD; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the assessment date, a month being whole once the assessment date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

The returned-payment entry the fee is for counts among the returned-payment entries when it falls inside the window.

## Truth table

| Returned-payment entries, last 6 months | Late fee, last 6 months | Late fee, last 12 months | Level |
|---|---|---|---|
| two or more | yes | yes | 25.00 |
| two or more | no | either | 15.00 |
| exactly one | no | no | 10.00 |
| exactly one | no | yes | 15.00 |
| exactly one | yes | yes | 15.00 |
| none | any | any | 15.00 |
